1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor, wherein said functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor is based on a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system, or a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6; and (B) an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, wherein each of components (A) and (B) is formulated in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof based on a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system, or a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6, an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof based on a pyrazinopyrimidone ring system, or a compound of formula I as defined in claim 6, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof, selected from the group consisting of renin inhibitors, ACE inhibitors, and AT1 receptor antagonists, in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

4. (Currently amended) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.
